info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Institution Login Reconnections API
info.description: The Customer Institution Login Reconnections API enables seamless reconnection of customers' institution login IDs within the financial services domain. This endpoint allows authorized users to initiate reconnection requests for specific customers, identified by their unique customer IDs. Businesses leveraging this API typically include banking and fintech companies looking to enhance user experience by simplifying login processes. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline customer access to financial applications and services, ensuring timely resolution of login issues.

post.summary: Reconnect a customer's institution login ID.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to reconnect a specific institution login ID for a customer. Ensure that the provided customer ID and institution login ID are valid and that the login ID was previously disconnected.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the reconnection process for a specific institution login ID associated with a customer. Ensure that all required fields are correctly populated to facilitate the successful processing of the request.
